L13·N11998unmasked layer
Fires on the word that completes a formulaic title/slogan phrase — e.g. "Years" after a numeral in "100 Years of…", the "AYS" of "HAPPY HOLIDAYS", the repeated word in tautological constructions ("You are you", "maps, maps and maps"), or the "means" in a brand tagline; it is strongly suppressed on ordinary predicate-completion words ("familiar", "simple", "made up", "seen it").

L18·N117unmasked layer
Weakly-selective, mostly syntactic neuron: it fires on short connective/function tokens completing a fixed collocation ("harmless **to** you", "start **with** them", "Best **of**", "re**-enable**", "text **color**", "__**ut**mb") and is strongly suppressed on determiner/preposition tokens like "the"/"on" in list- or fact-style contexts.
